question: How many cumulative confirmed Ebola cases will the DRC's 2026 outbreak have reported as of October 31, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Linear continuation of recent incidence. ECDC: 9,704 confirmed (data to 20 Oct); trackers: 9,876 as of 23 Oct. Recent rate ~57-71/day (14->20 Oct ~71/day, 20->23 Oct ~57/day; on 23 Oct Ituri's 28 cases = 46.7% of new, implying ~60 that day). About 8 data-days remain to 31 Oct, so +400-560 gives a median around 10,350. Uncertainty comes from whether the slowdown continues or a new province flares, and from which data day counts as the 31 Oct report (weekend, lagged ECDC updates). No matching human market: the Polymarket contracts found are country-spread questions, not this count.

- Substack headline (Proseko, Day 178): 'Congo's Ebola decline reverses as outbreak reaches eighth province' - evidence for renewed growth; Ituri day-level counts falling 37->28 - evidence for slowing.
- Status quo: continued ~55-75 new confirmed per day.
- Resolution: resolves off ECDC DRC cumulative confirmed for reporting date 31 Oct (Saturday; ECDC updates weekdays and lags one day; INSP sitrep as fallback); confirmed only, DRC only.
- Event window: cumulative to 31 Oct 2026 reporting date; as of 26 Oct the last known data point is 23 Oct, so about 8 data-days remain.
- Searched but not found: data for 24-25 Oct; any human prediction market on this count (Polymarket has only country-spread contracts).
calls.reference_class: Linear extrapolation of this outbreak's own cumulative confirmed series over 8-day windows (Sept-Oct 2026, ~1,000 cases per 13-16 days)

calls.reasoning: Latest firm figure 9,876 confirmed with data through 23 Oct (ebola-tracker), consistent with ECDC 9,704 (data to 20 Oct) and CDC 9,816 (~22 Oct). Weekly increments flat at ~460-490 (~68/day); 20-23 Oct ran ~57/day; using ~62/day. ECDC updates on weekdays only and dates each figure the day after its data, so its latest figure on/before 31 Oct is probably the 30 Oct update (data to 29 Oct) = ~10,250; an INSP 31 Oct figure would be ~10,375. Weighted ~55/45 toward the ECDC reading, giving a median ~10,310. Reaching 11,500 would need ~200/day, so no escape mass. No human market found: the Polymarket candidates are country-has-a-case contracts, not this count.
calls.reconciliation: Disputes: (1) date of the 9,876 figure — ebola-tracker states 'as of October 23'; CDC's 9,847 total minus 31 non-DRC cases gives a DRC 9,816 for ~22 Oct, consistent with +60 on 23 Oct. So the 9,876/23 Oct reading of Runs 1-2 is right; Run 3's 22 Oct dating overstates the count by about one day. (2) Daily rate 57 vs 68/day: judgment; the 18 Oct day had ~90 (Ituri 42, NK 48), and 20-23 Oct averaged ~57; I use ~62. (3) Which reporting day counts — none of the runs weighted this. ECDC's fetched page is still 'as of 21 Oct, data to 20 Oct'; ECDC's weekday-only updates make 30 Oct (data to 29 Oct) the likely resolving figure, which shifts the estimate down ~1-2 days versus the runs. A search for 24-25 Oct figures returned only a stale WSWS 9,552 figure and no new data.
